goal: Provide structured log entries to bitcoinkernel consumers instead of pre-formatted strings
Eliminate node-specific logging complexity and internal logging dependencies from the kernel library
agreement: Solid support with one unanswered objection
Support for rationalizing the kernel logging API and simplifying log consumption (ryanofsky, yuvicc)
Unaddressed objection: using singletons introduces viral coupling across kernel components (purpleKarrot)
Concerns about memory leaks, deadlocks, and argument side effects were resolved (ajtowns, w0xlt, musaHaruna)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it replaces brittle string parsing with structured log entries for kernel consumers
Removes node-specific logging code from the kernel build and unblocks downstream kernel PRs
